full_text_en:
Zhang Lianqi and Zhang Guoli v. Zhang Xuezhen — dispute over damages for personal injury

Plaintiff: Zhang Lianqi, male, 56 years old, worker at Tianjin Port No. 2 Stevedoring Company.

Agent ad litem: Liu Yong, lawyer from Tanggu District Legal Advisory Office, Tianjin.

Plaintiff: Zhang Guoli (daughter of Zhang Lianqi), female, 22 years old, unemployed, residing at No. 35, Building 16, Xinxin Kaili, Xingang, Tanggu District, Tianjin.

Defendant: Zhang Xuezhen, female, 53 years old, proprietor of Tianjin Tanggu Workers' New Village Youth Cooperative Service Station.

Agent ad litem: Xu Guangqiu (husband of defendant Zhang Xuezhen), agent for the business operations of Tianjin Tanggu Workers' New Village Youth Cooperative Service Station.

Agent ad litem: Yang Jinting, lawyer from Tianjin No. 4 Law Firm.

The case of plaintiffs Zhang Lianqi and Zhang Guoli v. defendant Zhang Xuezhen concerning a dispute over damages for personal injury was tried by the Tanggu District People's Court of Tianjin. The court found the following facts:

In October 1986, the Seventh Construction Team of the Construction Engineering Company under the Tianjin Tanggu District Production Service Administration Bureau subcontracted the demolition project of the calcium removal tower building of the Tianjin Alkali Plant to the defendant, individual business proprietor Zhang Xuezhen, who organized and led the Workers' New Village Youth Cooperative Service Station, and a subcontract agreement was signed. On November 17, 1986, Xu Guangqiu, the husband of defendant Zhang Xuezhen and the fully authorized agent for the business operations of the Service Station, organized and directed the construction. He personally led the hired temporary workers, including Zhang Guosheng, in demolishing the concrete beams. When dismantling the first to fourth beams, cracks appeared on the beams after lifting; when lifting the fifth beam, the middle of the beam fractured (sagged). This did not attract Xu Guangqiu's attention. When dismantling the sixth beam, the beam broke in the middle. Xu Guangqiu and Zhang Guosheng (son of plaintiff Zhang Lianqi), who were standing on the beam (neither wearing safety belts), slipped and fell to the ground. Zhang Guosheng was injured and was rushed to Tianjin Alkali Plant Hospital for examination. Examination revealed a blood swelling and tenderness on the inner side of the left ankle joint, with impaired mobility; X-ray film showed no fractures. After hospital treatment, a medical certificate was issued stating: left ankle joint contusion, rest for two days. On November 21, Zhang Guosheng was admitted to Port Hospital, but treatment was ineffective, and he died on December 7. The forensic examination by the Tianjin Municipal Forensic Medical Institute concluded that Zhang Guosheng's death was caused by local tissue infection and necrosis following a left inner ankle injury, leading to septicopyemia. Subsequently, the Tanggu District Medical Malpractice Appraisal Committee determined that Zhang Guosheng's death resulted from traumatic septicopyemia, septic shock, and multiple organ failure, and that the hospital's treatment was proper. Zhang Guosheng's death was unrelated to any other factors.

After Zhang Guosheng's work-related injury, the Service Station promptly sent him to the hospital for examination and treatment; after his death, it paid for his funeral. In addition, the plaintiffs incurred losses totaling RMB 17,600.40, including medical expenses borrowed for Zhang Guosheng's treatment and lost wages for his family members.

After Zhang Guosheng's death, the parties jointly requested the Tanggu District Labor Bureau to rule on who should bear the economic losses incurred. After investigation, the Labor Bureau proposed the following resolution: (1) Medical expenses during Zhang Guosheng's hospitalization were to be borne by the Service Station; the Service Station was to pay a one-time solatium of RMB 2,000 to Zhang Guosheng's family, and would assume no other obligations or liabilities. Zhang Lianqi and Zhang Guoli accepted the above opinion, but Zhang Xuezhen refused. Subsequently, Zhang Lianqi and Zhang Guoli filed a lawsuit with the Tanggu District People's Court, requesting that the defendant compensate for all economic losses and resolve the housing issue of plaintiff Zhang Guoli.

The defendant argued: When Zhang Guosheng (the son of plaintiff Zhang Lianqi) signed the registration form upon joining the station, he agreed to the statement that "the station is not responsible for work-related injuries"; the cause of Zhang Guosheng's death was unclear. Based on this, the defendant could not meet the plaintiffs' demands and could only provide a certain amount of living subsidy to Zhang Guosheng's family according to the actual circumstances; the Service Station had no obligation to resolve Zhang Guoli's housing issue.

After trial, the Tanggu District People's Court found that Xu Guangqiu, the fully authorized agent for the business operations of defendant Zhang Xuezhen, in organizing and directing the construction, not only failed to follow operating procedures and led the workers in violating work rules, but also, after discovering hidden dangers of accidents, failed to take preventive measures. His psychological characteristics were such that he knew or should have known that an accident might occur but neglected or lightly believed that it could be avoided. Therefore, this accident was a negligent liability accident. The appraisal confirmed that Zhang Guosheng's death was caused by a work-related injury and was unrelated to any other factors. The Constitution of our country explicitly provides for labor protection for workers. This is a right enjoyed by workers and is protected by national law; no individual or organization may arbitrarily infringe upon it. Defendant Zhang Xuezhen, as an employer, should have provided labor protection to her employees in accordance with the law. However, she noted in the recruitment registration form: "not responsible for work-related injuries." This violates the Constitution and relevant labor laws and regulations, and also seriously violates socialist public morals; it constitutes an invalid civil act. Pursuant to Article 106, paragraph 2, of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the PRC, the defendant, having infringed upon Zhang Guosheng's personal safety through fault, shall bear civil liability. Pursuant to Article 119 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the PRC, the defendant shall compensate for the medical expenses incurred before Zhang Guosheng's death, the reduced income of his family members due to lost work, and the living expenses of persons supported by the deceased during his lifetime.

Based on the clarified facts and a clear distinction of rights, wrongs, and responsibilities, the Tanggu District People's Court, in accordance with Article 97 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC (for Trial Implementation), presided over the mediation of the parties on December 24, 1988, and the following agreement was reached:

1. Defendant Zhang Xuezhen shall pay RMB 18,000 in compensation to plaintiffs Zhang Lianqi and Zhang Guoli, to be paid in six installments from January 1989 to December 10, 1989, with RMB 3,000 paid each time.

2. The appraisal fee of RMB 120 shall be borne by the defendant.

The case acceptance fee of RMB 170 shall be borne by the defendant.
